★In Switzerland it is illegal to keep a guinea pig on its own.★A group of crows is called a murder.★So far, two diseases have been eradicated: smallpox and rinderpest.★7% of American adults believe that chocolate milk comes from brown cows.★Bananas curve because they grow towards the sun.★Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.★Archaeologists have found honey in Egyptian tombs that was thousands of years old and still edible.★A group of flamingos is called a flamboyance.★The shortest war in history lasted 38 to 45 minutes, between Britain and Zanzibar.★Scotland's national animal is the unicorn.★There are more possible games of chess than atoms in the observable universe.★The inventor of the Pringles can had some of his ashes buried in one.★Dolphins have signature whistles that work like names.★The moon has moonquakes.★Wombat poop is cube-shaped.★One species of jellyfish can turn itself back into a juvenile, again and again.★Sloths can hold their breath longer than dolphins can.★The Eiffel Tower grows up to 15 centimeters taller in summer heat.★A single cloud can weigh more than a million pounds.★The longest hiccuping spree lasted 68 years.
